what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Hybrid: in person at LMS Collaborative Room #D132 or on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID 832 2784 7126); also broadcast later on local access cable, Facebook and YouTube

items.agenda_line: 14. Executive Session- pursuant to Massachusetts General
items.why_it_matters: The committee may close this part to discuss complaints brought against a public officer, employee, staff member, or individual (under M.G.L. c. 30A, section 21(a)(1)); the public cannot attend that part.
The committee is listed to ratify a contract for the school café, filed under Action items.
The committee reviews and approves the bill-payment warrants for this period, along with any line item transfers and donations listed under the same item.

items.agenda_line: b. Participation of students not affiliated with LHS in Homecoming
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to discuss whether students who do not attend Lunenburg High School may take part in Homecoming.

items.agenda_line: a. Update on Current Capital Projects
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to receive an update on capital projects now under way in district buildings, with the Director of Facilities named as a guest.
The committee is listed to discuss the capital plan for fiscal year 2028.
The committee is listed to discuss the turf field and retaining walls.
